metadata.title: The completion: a relativistic field theory carrying a_0 = kappa c sqrt(G rho_Lambda)
metadata.description:
v7 (2026-08-10, late) -- THE LARGEST POSITIVE STRUCTURAL CHANGE OF THE PROGRAMME: a_0(z) IS DERIVED FROM THE ACTION. Until v7 the redshift scaling of a_0 was imposed as a phenomenological law dressed in DESI's CPL parameters -- a dressing never self-consistent with this paper's own w = -1 exact, here withdrawn and replaced. The derivation (new sec. 1.3, rows 18-19): promote the constant a_0^2 to a_0^2(Q) = kappa^2 c^2 G(-K(Q))/c^2 -- THE MOND SCALE IS THE DARK SECTOR'S PRESSURE (p = K is an identity in this sector). Zero new parameters; ONE new relation mu^2 Lambda_D^2 = M^4 ('the Lagrangian vanishes at the DBI wall'), which REMOVES a free parameter (5 -> 4). Today -K = rho_Lambda: the committed coefficient to the digit. Into the past the trace excitation's positive pressure climbs the DBI wall and cancels the vacuum's negative pressure: MOND switches off at recombination AS AN OUTPUT, with w = -1 still exact -- the vacuum never rolls; the TOTAL pressure evolves. The competing density promotion (a_0^2 propto rho_Q) is excluded by one bit (a_0 would rise into the past; an adversarial external pass -- Google Gemini -- independently proved it also gives a_0 = const on the vacuum branch, and is credited in row 18). Closed-form law: a_0^2(z)/a_0^2(0) = sqrt(1+nu_0^2)/sqrt(1+nu_0^2(1+z)^6); constant to <1% for z <= 5; transition z_t in [17, 35]; off at recombination (0.002-0.006); NO bump at z ~ 0.5. Window nu_0 in [2.1e-5, 1.8e-4], cut from below by the CMB off-switch and from above by the RAR via the drain bound -- non-claim 2d's ADVERSE result is load-bearing here. Row 19: the full perturbation matrix with the new F_YQ mixing -- the cosmological matrix is untouched EXACTLY (h^00 = 0 to all orders kills delta Y at first order; every new entry vanishes on FRW), the no-ghost theorem TRANSFERS kernel-independently (both kinetic additions PSD in the same slot; Weyl monotonicity), c_T = 1 survives, mixing corrections trace-bounded at ~1.5e-4. Also in v7: stage 15's claim that the Hooper et al. 2022 generic-shape forest likelihood is public was WRONG (announced, never released; all probes 404) -- the sector's forest suppression is instead SELF-COMPUTED by a lognormal mock (0.20% at the binding bin, nuisance-dominated, stage16). NOT claimed (non-claim 2e): beta = 1 is SELECTED by the off-switch, not derived; the DESI phantom-past tension is not resolved and cannot be (w_rem >= -1 always); owed: the CLASS re-run with the derived law, the MUSE/MSA-3D re-exam against the bumpless shape, a referee-grade covariant SVT decomposition.

v6 (2026-08-10) -- AN ERRATUM AGAINST v5, FILED AGAINST MY OWN ARGUMENT. v5's non-claim 2d rested one of its three steps on a CATEGORY ERROR: it bounded the EXPORT of the dust's energy from a galaxy by the khronon's own polytropic sound speed (~690 Gyr). grad_mu T^munu = 0 bounds the TOTAL ENERGY, not the FLUX VELOCITY; the bound on how fast energy can leave a region is CAUSALITY, and AeST has two massless tensor modes at exactly c -- by this paper's own row 17 -- so an O(c) export channel exists in the theory as written (1 Mpc in 3.3 Myr, faster by 2.1e5). THAT STEP IS WITHDRAWN. Also withdrawn: that the leak rates 'lock' at rho_Lambda/rho_dust = 2.60, which is merely today's density ratio. THE CONCLUSION SURVIVES ON STRONGER, PUBLISHED, TRANSPORT-INDEPENDENT GROUNDS: exporting the energy removes it from the GALAXY, not the UNIVERSE, so the measured global budget decides. A halo-gated conversion to dark radiation needs a converted fraction zeta ~ 0.6 against the EPOCH-MARGINALISED bound zeta < 0.0204 (Planck primary CMB) to 0.0374 (+lensing+BAO+SN+DES) [McCarthy & Hill, PRD 108 063501, arXiv:2210.14339] -- over by 16-29x -- and would leave Omega_dr,0 ~ 0.196, about 2100x today's radiation density; the dust-to-dark-energy channel needs far more than the published |delta_0| <= 6.7e-4. And the halo gate is ADVERSE rather than protective: dilution goes as a_c, so later injection leaves MORE residue (a 74x penalty). A further fact against interest: a lifetime equal to the free-fall time does not CLEAR a galaxy, it only stops runaway collapse -- the standing dust would still be 7.4x the L* baryonic mass. THE LENSING THEOREM (dynamics responds to rho+3p, lensing to rho+p, and no equation of state kills both) IS UNTOUCHED AND IS WHAT CARRIES THE RESULT. Banked as a genuine asset: the Y-gated construction's FRW exactness (Y vanishes identically on the background, and is second order in perturbations) makes recombination-era N_eff immunity EXACT rather than fine-tuned, so shift-symmetry breaking is NOT dead -- the relativistic-sink disposal channel is what died. Also recorded, against expectation: the BACKGROUND does not require dark matter at all (Kunz's dark degeneracy, confirmed numerically -- a single free w_X(z) reproduces LCDM's H(z) with baryons alone); the binding constraint is CMB LENSING, which forces the clustering to survive to z < 0.30. Four new route scripts and an audit script are added as evidence.

v5 (same day) -- THE LARGEST REVISION, AND IT RUNS AGAINST THE PROGRAMME'S INTEREST. A six-stage sequence (nbody_2026/, every stage committed and green) settles the galaxy-interior question v3 reopened as non-claim 2d, and settles it ADVERSELY: the Q-sector cannot ALSO be absent from galaxies, and the repair space of local, energy-preserving modifications is provably EMPTY. Three results carry it, each more general than the mechanism it killed. (i) THE DUST MASS IS THE CONSERVED SHIFT CHARGE: exactly, rho_exc = Q_0 n with rho/n = Q_0 independently of ANY added Y-dependent Q-mass, of any shape or amplitude -- so a locally conserved charge cannot be locally suppressed, only moved (gravity moves it inward) or not conserved. This single statement accounts for three withdrawn mechanisms: the primordial shift-charge route, a Phi^n environment response, and an acceleration-gated suppressor built and killed here (its eight gates all tested the field amplitude u; the observable is n, and at fixed charge the suppressor makes a region a CHEAPER place to store charge). (ii) UNLOCKING THE CHARGE DOES NOT UNLOCK THE ENERGY: a global shift-breaking potential is incompatible as an identity (dV/dt = V' phidot must vanish for w = -1 while the condensate needs phidot = Q_0 nonzero; the leak rates lock at rho_Lambda/rho_dust = 2.60, so clearing a galaxy in 1 Gyr drifts Lambda by 47x), and a Y-GATED breaking defeats that -- on FRW the symmetry stays EXACT -- but grad_mu T^munu = 0 holds regardless, and transporting the energy out of a galaxy takes 690 Gyr at the sector's own polytropic sound speed. (iii) NO EQUATION OF STATE HIDES ENERGY FROM BOTH ORBITS AND LIGHT: the quasi-static source rho + 3p vanishes at exactly f = 1/3 (plausibly a stable fixed point, since the gate responds to local field strength), but lensing responds to rho + p, still (2/3)rho there, giving M_lens/M_dyn = 29 against an observed 1.0-1.3; generally rho+3p = 0 needs w = -1/3 and rho+p = 0 needs w = -1, which are incompatible, so only rho = 0 is invisible to both and (ii) forbids reaching it. THE IRONY IS EXACT: the no-slip identity Phi = Psi that makes the modified-gravity arm work -- the property that killed the modified-inertia arm at 21 sigma and underwrites row 1 -- is the same property that forbids hiding the dust. Along the way stage 3 found the endpoint of an unimpeded collapse (wave/k^4 support is 0.18 AU at halo density and SHRINKS as density grows; the dust is an n=1 polytrope with a mass-independent 105 pc equilibrium that lies 14.4x past DBI saturation where the sound speed collapses; endpoint a black hole, falsified 5.8e5x against Sgr A* from individual stellar orbits). TWO EARLIER CLAIMS OF OURS ARE WITHDRAWN HERE: that the DBI cap bounds the dust DENSITY (mu^2 u^2/2 is the PRESSURE; rho_exc is LINEAR in u and diverges at saturation), and v4's spliced amplitude band. The defensible slogan is now 'no dark-matter PARTICLE' and nothing more; 'none in galaxies' is WITHDRAWN as a claim of this theory. Rows 1-12 and 15-17 -- lensing, the CMB, the RAR, the solar system, the no-ghost theorem, c_T = 1 and the a_0 coefficient -- are untouched.

v4 (same day, hours after v3): a second adversarial re-review caught residual overclaims, fixed here with the program's usual prominence: (i) the RAR comparison is restated honestly -- the 0.108-dex fit at the anchored a0 uses the framework's Milgrom-1999-shape interpolation (data-degenerate with the completion kernel, whose functional form is McGaugh-Lelli-Schombert 2016's empirical function, now credited as such), and with the mass-to-light ratio refit on both sides the RAR does NOT discriminate the anchored a0 from the fitted literature value: anchoring buys a cheaper fit, not a better one; (ii) three stale pointers to withdrawn row 13 (non-claim 4, the scatter-prediction row, and the credit line's 'resolves') are corrected; (iii) the nbody stage-1 postscript is recorded in non-claim 2d: the DBI sound-crossing discriminant (nbody_2026/stage1_condensate_relaxation_2026.py, 11/11) narrows the dust-settling problem to a two-sided bound 1.2e-9 <= Lam_D <= 8.4e-7, with galaxy outskirts frozen at ~Mpc radii either way; 2d remains open pending stages 2-3. The peer-review-format paper is updated to match.

v3 (same day): (i) the FULL AeST perturbation matrix for the a0-bump term is DONE and added as row 17: c_T = 1 exactly (the new terms are algebraic in the metric -- GW170817 safe by construction); NO-GHOST IS A THEOREM (the bump's kinetic addition is rank-one positive semi-definite, so by Weyl monotonicity it cannot lower any eigenvalue of AeST's healthy kinetic matrix); the quasi-static phenomenology is DERIVED from the unit-norm constraint (delta A^0 = -Phi A^0); the amplitude cap softens to A_max = (2.7-7.4)x fiducial pending one coefficient of the Skordis-Zlosnik supplemental -- Mistele's demanding 34x end stays excluded by more than 7x, the 4x edge is now marginal; open flags: a lambda-suppressed tachyon-type vector mass (watch item) and the known k < mu unboundedness relocating to the Hubble scale at mu^-1 = 4392 Mpc. (ii) NON-CLAIM 2 IS CORRECTED, against interest: v2's "and by item 13 it is absent where rotation curves are measured" was a dangling pointer -- v2 itself withdrew row 13 -- so the galaxy-interior status of the Q-sector dust is REOPENED and stated as its own open problem (non-claim 2d): the favorable branch (relaxation to the Helmholtz-preferred centrally-evacuated profile) and the fatal branch (CDM-like concentration, overshooting the RAR by 2.06-4.42x) are both computable, and the deciding nonlinear relaxation calculation has never been performed for AeST by any group. The defensible slogan shrinks to "no dark-matter particle". (iii) A peer-review-format paper (THE_COMPLETION_PAPER.tex/pdf, RevTeX) and the full-matrix script are added.

v2 (same day): the shift-charge cluster route of v1 is WITHDRAWN, killed by the 1-Mpc confrontation: cluster R500 and galaxy-outskirt lensing share a scale with disjoint requirements, correlated Gaussian initial conditions cannot select environments (conditional expectation is linear), and smooth accretion restores xi to order unity for any cold initial condition. It is replaced by the a0-BUMP ENVIRONMENT RESPONSE: one cross term A B(Y/a0^2)(Q-Q0)^2 with B(y) = y/(1+y)^2, a position-dependent Helmholtz mass PEAKED AT THE FRAMEWORK OWN a0 -- clusters are the cosmic objects that live at the MOND transition (R500 sits at 0.33-0.58 a0). It passes all five environments (cluster calibration; galaxy interior 0.034 percent of M_b; galaxy 1 Mpc at 1.2 percent vs the 5.9 percent strict weak-lensing bound; linear cosmos 0.6 percent of mean matter; solar 1e-19), vanishes on the FRW background and enters perturbations at second order (linear CMB and P(k) untouched by construction), and SURVIVES ITS PERTURBATION HEALTH CHECK with teeth: no ghosts ever, no Ostrogradsky sector, FRW gradient health forces Lam_D below 8.4e-7 (excluding the old fiducial outright; the window remains 3.7 orders wide), and halo gradient health caps the amplitude at 2.7x fiducial, excluding the demanding end of the Mistele-McGaugh-Hossenfelder cluster band in a two-sided falsifiable pinch. The coefficient row now reads as MEASURED: kappa = 0.551 +/- 0.043, or +/- 0.063 carrying the H0 tension. Three scripts added.

The assembled action. This is the framework's relativistic field theory written down in one place: Aether-Scalar-Tensor (Skordis & Zlosnik 2021) with a factorised free function F(Y,Q) = (a0^2/8 pi G) F_Y(Y/a0^2) + K(Q), where the Y-sector is the framework's own Route A kernel nu(y) = 1/(1 - e^-sqrt(y)) and K(Q) is an OFFSET DBI form whose minimum supplies Lambda (w = -1 exactly), whose deviations supply the dark matter, and whose saturation removes the early stiff phase. One function, three jobs.

Fourteen verified properties, each backed by a named committed script that exits non-zero on failure: lensing cleared quantitatively (gamma_PPN = 1, M_dyn/M_lens = 1, turning a 21.2-sigma exclusion into 0.601 sigma); the kernel's embedding (deep-MOND exact, Newtonian limit, bijection, convex free function); a Newtonian residual of 3.6e-3457 at Earth's orbit; dark energy from the condensate minimum, proved not assumed; ghost-freedom and subluminality over the whole field range; the dissolution of Blanchet & Skordis 2024's published 455x no-go, with a theorem showing only BOUNDEDNESS reaches w = 0; CMB acoustic peaks verified by a real CAMB+CLASS run (TT unchanged to 0.069%); exact BTFR; the g^-2 Lorentz-violation prediction restored by the aether; a0 tied to Lambda to 0.076%; clusters from a primordial shift charge, which resolves the 2500x objection of Mistele, McGaugh & Hossenfelder 2023; and a directional external-field signal already firing at p = 0.029 with the predicted sign.

Honest parameter count: FOUR dark-sector numbers against LCDM's two. Not fewer -- what is bought is that Lambda, dark matter and MOND come from ONE function rather than three unrelated sectors.

Eight explicit non-claims, led by: kappa = 1/2 IS NOT DERIVED. It is a relabelling whose residue is convention-dependent, and the framework's own de Sitter-Unruh heuristic must NOT be cited as support for it -- that construction derives the interpolation function exactly (it is Milgrom 1999 eq. 9) and simultaneously forces an a0 excluded by SPARC at 15.6 sigma. Dark matter EXISTS in this completion at the full Omega_dm; the defensible statement is "no dark-matter PARTICLE, and none in galaxies", never "no dark matter". Also not claimed: a resolution of clusters (11-26% of LCDM's dark mass is still required at R500), the post-recombination growth history, or PPN alpha_1/alpha_2 for this free function.

Six falsifiable predictions, including the hash-stamped Gaia DR4 wide-binary target (Amendment 9, filed 2026-08-09, gamma_v = 1.2139 canonical / 1.2592 alt, registered PROVISIONAL) and a cluster-to-cluster scatter test that separates two competing cluster mechanisms on existing data.

Full credit is given in the paper: nu = sqrt(1 + 1/y) is Milgrom 1999 PLA 253:273 eq. 9; AQUAL is Bekenstein & Milgrom 1984; AeST is Skordis & Zlosnik 2021; the ghost condensate is Arkani-Hamed, Cheng, Luty & Mukohyama 2004. The distinctive content is the coefficient a0 = kappa c sqrt(G rho_Lambda), its embedding in the Y-sector, the offset-DBI Q-sector, and the results listed above.

AI-assisted research. Every quantitative claim is reproducible from the committed scripts.
